<a2ui-json>
{
  "version": "v0.9.1",
  "createSurface": {
    "surfaceId": "subscription-tiers-surface",
    "catalogId": "https://a2uicatalog.ai/catalog/c-marketing-commerce.json"
  }
}
</a2ui-json>
